note: Which sheets each trade reads, and which trades sit at a seam with each other. The trade files carry how a trade bids and splits itself; they do not carry sheet families, so this file holds them. It is read by scripts/plan_inventory.py to write the window 2 plan and by scripts/cut_pass_knowledge.py to resolve a catalog id to a trade file. Keys are catalog trade ids verbatim, spaced the way the catalog spaces them, one code per trade file. A trade file is general to its family, so a package carrying some other code resolves to the nearest broader CSI section this file does key: 04 22 13 finds 04 20 00. Codes are not added here to make that work. Where a division maps exactly one trade file, that file is keyed at the division header, since the file is general to everything in it; a division mapping several files keeps each at its own section, and a package drafted on that bare division header reaches no trade file rather than one of several picked for it. A family names a discipline, a set of sheet numbers, or both, narrowed by sheet type; a trade whose families name no sheet in a set reads nothing in that set and is named on the plan's bounds line. Schedules are deliberately not a family: a schedule reaches a trade through definitionKinds, so a trade gets the schedules that define its own marks rather than every schedule in the set. These families are this plugin's own judgment about where a trade's work is drawn, not a reading of any project.

unmapped.prefab-balconies: no catalog trade fits: the catalog carries no prefabricated balcony trade, and misc metals, precast concrete and special construction each cover only part of it. Left unmapped rather than routing balcony scope into a trade that would price only part of it.

01 00 00.note: final cleaning is drawn nowhere: it is a general conditions trade whose scope comes from the spec and the schedule, not from a sheet family. Keyed at the division because it is the only trade file mapped in it, so a package drafted anywhere in division 01 reaches it; the section this file was drawn from is 01 74 23 final cleaning.

02 41 00.note: demolition rides on its own discipline. A set that draws demolition on the architectural sheets instead carries none here, and the lead adds it with an include pattern.

02 80 00.note: abatement is drawn on the demolition sheets where it is drawn at all; most of its scope is in the hazardous materials survey, which is not a drawing.

04 00 00.note: keyed at the division because it is the only trade file mapped in it, so a package drafted anywhere in division 04 reaches it; the section this file was drawn from is 04 20 00 unit masonry, and 04 00 00 as a key would otherwise be a division header no package could resolve to.

05 12 00.note: the frame: fabrication and erection, with deck and joists riding inside the package in this market. Keyed at its own section rather than the division, because division 05 now maps two trade files. Steel decking at 05 31 00 and steel erectors at 05 60 00 are deliberately not keyed: a package drafted on either reaches no trade file and is named on the plan's bounds line, which is honest, where routing it to one of two files would be a guess. The boundary with misc metals runs by framing type rather than by item, so the same item can belong here at the steel-framed levels and to misc metals at the wood-framed levels above.

05 50 00.note: metal fabrications, the section this file was drawn from. Re-keyed here from the bare division when structural steel earned its own file: a division mapping several files keeps each at its own section, so a package drafted on 05 00 00 alone now reaches no trade file rather than one of two picked for it. A single combined metals package is common in this market and reaches only one of the two files, which is why the two are declared a seam below.

08 34 00.note: a partial fit: the catalog id is the elevator door smoke containment section, and this trade also covers smoke curtains that are not at an elevator. The wider scope reaches the pass through the sheet families, not through the id.

27 00 00.note: security and fire alarm are separate catalog sections. Where the project buys them with the low voltage package, they ride as extra sections on that package rather than as a second trade here.

32 00 00.note: keyed at the division because it is the only trade file mapped in it, so a package drafted anywhere in division 32 reaches it; the section this file was drawn from is 32 90 00 planting.
